title: Primordial Ore
description: Mod that adds new ores and utilities to your game.
body:
# **🌋 Primordial Ore 🏗️**
## 🔹 New Ores & Resources

**Multiple new minerals such as Endium, Rubi, Pyronite, Enderite, and more.**

**Each ore comes with refined items, crafting components or special abilities.**

## 🔹 Essences System

**Collect Elemental Essences from advanced items and late-game processes.**

**Use them to upgrade gear, unlock effects, or craft rare materials.**

## 🔹 New Tools & Armor Sets

**Pyronite gear with Overheat mechanics.**

**Enderite gear with Distortion visual effects.**

**Special tools like the Pyronite Excavator and Enderite ShardBlade.**

## 🔹 Utility Blocks

**Miner Beacon: doubles ore drops within its radius.**

**Additional crafting blocks linked to ores and essences.**

## 🔹 Vanilla-Friendly Design

**No dimensions, no mobs, no complex machines.**

**Everything integrates naturally into the survival mining progression.**


----------------------------


**Stay tuned for future updates! If you enjoy the mod, consider leaving a review! ⭐**

**You have a good idea for the mods or you encounter any bug, then send me a dm on discord : Jango660**

**The statistic of the mod can be found here : [Stats Primordial Ore](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1qqpU88dOspIizFuugH-YRmzUPDoOr6IOxKwMlbNKp0w/edit?usp=sharing)**
